title: Adaptation Regret of Honest Intervals to an Unknown Cap on Harmful Responses
banked_reason: The required sharp, evaluable all-cap regret expansion is not delivered: the core explicitly leaves its normalization, coefficient/atlas, certified evaluator, matching lower certificates, and asymptotically matching cap-blind construction unresolved, while proving only finite attainment and non-sharp/conditional ceilings.
gap_reasons: The required sharp, evaluable all-cap regret expansion is not delivered: the core explicitly leaves its normalization, coefficient/atlas, certified evaluator, matching lower certificates, and asymptotically matching cap-blind construction unresolved, while proving only finite attainment and non-sharp/conditional ceilings.

The delivered results are an exact finite count-game reduction, exhaustive LP attainment and complete-table dual certificates, together with the one-unit value A_1=1/20. Unconditionally, the asymptotic conclusions are only A_n→0 and the endpoint-spread upper bound; no positive growing-n regret lower rate, evaluated leading coefficient or sharp all-cap tradeoff is established. The n^(-5/6) ceiling and causal intermediate-cap separation depend on unproved oracle accuracy and discrete transfers, while the spectral comparison and fixed-window root calculation do not discharge those steps; the separate known-cap proposal is explicitly unpublished and unresolved, and its status alone is not a novelty penalty. The TL;DR and justification disclose these limitations without a stale assertion of a matched frontier, but the advertised sharp adaptation price remains an open research objective. Relative to the credited [count-experiment reduction](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.13822) and [bounded-offset confidence-regret framework, Section 5](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~stark/Preprints/schaferStark09.pdf), the delivered extension supplies setup machinery rather than a field-level precision theorem. The projected score of 3.2 reflects that limited contribution and the absence of an evaluated uniform tradeoff or supporting computations beyond n=1, with exhaustive vertex enumeration providing neither a scalable procedure nor evidence of the proposed refinement.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the cap-preserving finite reduction, finite saddle attainment, complete-table dual lifts, one-unit regret value and endpoint-spread bound, and repaired LP and spectral source evidence. The delivered claims passed the math referee, but the sharp asymptotic price still requires weighted discrete transfer, independently accurate known-cap oracles, evaluated lower certificates and a uniform connected attainer. Independent terminal review confirmed incremental tier below the field floor; banked downgraded with retry status rather than treating the missing kernel as proved.
tldr: The simultaneous adaptation value \(A_n\) is exactly attained by a total cap-blind finite interval algorithm, with compatible complete-table lower certificates against every allowed assignment design. This round proves \(0\le A_n\le\ell_n(n)-\ell_n(0)\) and the oracle-error comparison \(A_n\le F(n,0)-F(n,n)+2e_n\). Independent oracle accuracy gives a conditional order ceiling. The sharp first nonzero coefficient, weighted discrete transfer and matching analytically specified regular-score connected construction remain open.
gap: Schafer--Stark allows bounded offsets and pointwise-oracle regret; its generic theory leaves the nested harm-cap schedule and sharp all-design binary causal evaluation unevaluated.
fill: An evaluated expansion for \(A_n\), an operational oracle-error transfer lemma, compatible complete-table lower certificates, and one total honest interval determine simultaneous precision without maintaining a cap for coverage. The known-cap frontier supplies a dependency rather than a second contribution.
